title: Nature Reserve
source_topic: ICPC / The 2016 ACM - Asia Nha Trang Regional Contest
statement: Stations form a connected weighted network; activating the channel between two stations costs a given amount, and afterwards transmitting the L-byte program across it costs L more. The program starts installed on S given stations and must reach every station. The task is the minimum total energy, with up to 10^4 stations and 10^6 channels.
